_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Killing Floor 2 egg in https://github.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd (MIT).
name: Killing Floor 2
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The co-op shooter of waves of Zeds, for up to six players. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with its web admin if you want it.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/container/Binaries/Win64/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"; exec ./Binaries/Win64/KFGameSteamServer.bin.x86_64 "{{MAP_NAME}}?Game=KFGameContent.KFGameInfo_{{GAME_MODE}}?Difficulty={{DIFFICULTY}}?GameLength={{GAME_LENGTH}}?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}?Port={{SERVER_PORT}}?QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}}${ADMIN_PASS:+?AdminPassword=$ADMIN_PASS}${GAME_PASSWORD:+?GamePassword=$GAME_PASSWORD}" {{EXTRA_FLAGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Killing Floor 2. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 232130) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously.
# Configs and the workshop cache are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-232130}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# Killing Floor 2 writes its config files the first time it runs, and only
# then: start it once, here, so the Panel has them to set the server name,
# web admin and takeover in at every start. Existing ones are left alone.
cfg=KFGame/Config
mkdir -p KFGame/Cache
if [ ! -f "$cfg/LinuxServer-KFGame.ini" ] || [ ! -f "$cfg/KFWeb.ini" ] || [ ! -f "$cfg/LinuxServer-KFEngine.ini" ]; then
    echo "Starting the server once to create its config files"
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/mnt/server/Binaries/Win64/lib64 ./Binaries/Win64/KFGameSteamServer.bin.x86_64 kf-bioticslab > .raptor-firstrun.log 2>&1 &
    pid=$!
    for _ in $(seq 1 300); do
        [ -f "$cfg/LinuxServer-KFGame.ini" ] && [ -f "$cfg/KFWeb.ini" ] && [ -f "$cfg/LinuxServer-KFEngine.ini" ] && break
        kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
        sleep 1
    done
    sleep 5
    kill -INT "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    for _ in $(seq 1 30); do kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 1; done
    kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    if [ ! -f "$cfg/LinuxServer-KFGame.ini" ] || [ ! -f "$cfg/KFWeb.ini" ] || [ ! -f "$cfg/LinuxServer-KFEngine.ini" ]; then
        tail -n 20 .raptor-firstrun.log || true
        fail "The server didn't create its config files on its first run (its last lines are above). Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    rm -f .raptor-firstrun.log
    echo "Made the config files."
fi
echo "Installed Killing Floor 2 build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as KF-BioticsLab or KF-BurningParis.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: Survival, VersusSurvival (players as Zeds), WeeklySurvival (the weekly outbreak) or Endless.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: 0 Normal, 1 Hard, 2 Suicidal or 3 Hell on Earth.

variables.name: Game length
variables.description: 0 short (4 waves), 1 medium (7 waves) or 2 long (10 waves).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once; the game is made for 6.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for admin commands and the web admin, or empty for none.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Web admin
variables.description: Run the web admin page on Web admin port (true or false); it needs an admin password.

variables.name: Web admin port
variables.description: The port of the web admin page; give it an allocation to use it.

variables.name: Server takeover
variables.description: Let the game's matchmaking use the server for other players' matches while it's empty (true or false).

variables.name: Extra options
variables.description: More command-line options for the server, such as -multihome=1.2.3.4.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
